# Annualized mean return (arithmetic) (`annualized_arithmetic_mean`)

*Category: Return summary · Nature: estimated · Unit: decimal_return · Formula id: `annualized_arithmetic_mean@v1` · Methodology 0.1.0*

## 1. What does it measure?

Average per-period return scaled to a year without compounding.

## 2. Formula

```text
P * mean(r_t)
```

## 3. Required inputs

Periodic simple returns with a regular frequency.

## 4. Is higher or lower better?

Higher is better.

## 5. Plain-language interpretation

The average return per year if yearly results were simply added up; usually higher than the compounded annual return.

## 6. Professional interpretation

Linear annualization of the sample mean; the return component of the canonical annualized Sharpe ratio. Differs from CAGR by roughly half the variance.

## 7. Assumptions

- Linear time scaling of the mean.

## 8. When can it be misleading?

- Used as a proxy for realized compounded growth.

## 9. Minimum sensible data

One observation; low confidence below 3 years. (policy `location`: Mean-type estimates: low confidence below 3 years, moderate below 5 years.)
